title: Camman18 Golden Dandelion
description: This sound pack has 1 purpose: make golden dandelions play Camman's "The Golden Dandelion" SFX.
body:
This pretty random pack makes right clicking a baby mob with a golden dandelion sound like the golden dandelion meme from Camman18. Simple, just makes life easier in one way. 
**Only compatiple with 26.1.**
